name: Stella Smart FAQ – AI FAQ Generator & Schema Builder
author: mariastellatech

sections.description:
Stella Smart FAQ is the ultimate AI-powered FAQ generator for WordPress. Instead of spending hours manually thinking of questions and writing answers, let AI read your content and generate highly relevant, SEO-optimized FAQs in seconds.

Whether you run a WooCommerce store, a blog, or a corporate site, providing quick answers to your visitors reduces support tickets and improves user satisfaction. Even better, Stella Smart FAQ automatically applies JSON-LD FAQ Schema to your pages, greatly increasing your chances of capturing rich snippets in Google Search results.

🚀 Why Choose Stella Smart FAQ?

  • Bring Your Own AI: We don’t lock you into a proprietary service. Use your own API key to connect to OpenAI (ChatGPT), Anthropic (Claude), Google Gemini, or OpenRouter. You control the costs and the model!
  • Instant SEO Boost: Automatically adds Google-compliant FAQPage JSON-LD schema markup so your FAQs can appear directly in search engine results.
  • Smart Analytics: Not just a generator! See exactly which FAQs your users are searching for and identify “Unanswered Questions” so you know exactly what content to write next.
  • Seamless WordPress Integration: Includes a native Gutenberg block and shortcode support, so you can display your beautiful, accordion-style FAQs anywhere on your site.

⚡ Built for Performance

We know site speed matters. Stella Smart FAQ is incredibly lightweight, only loading scripts and styles on the exact pages where an FAQ is displayed. No unnecessary bloat, no sluggish admin panels.

Features

  • AI FAQ generator from post/page content
  • Choose AI provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, OpenRouter)
  • FAQ custom post type for manual management
  • Shortcode and Gutenberg block
  • FAQ search with analytics tracking
  • FAQPage schema output
  • Admin dashboard for opportunities and unanswered questions

External Services

This plugin connects to external AI services only when you configure an API provider and use AI features (Fetch Models, Test Connection, Generate AI FAQs).

  1. OpenAI

* Service purpose: Generates FAQ content and returns available model IDs.
* Data sent: API key (server-side authorization), selected model, prompt instructions, and the post/page content you choose to process.
* When sent: When clicking Fetch Models, Test Connection, or Generate AI FAQs.
* Terms of Service: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/
* Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/

  1. Anthropic

* Service purpose: Generates FAQ content and returns available model IDs.
* Data sent: API key (server-side authorization), selected model, prompt instructions, and the post/page content you choose to process.
* When sent: When clicking Fetch Models, Test Connection, or Generate AI FAQs.
* Terms of Service: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/consumer-terms
* Privacy Policy: https://www.anthropic.com/privacy

  1. Google Gemini API

* Service purpose: Generates FAQ content and returns available model IDs.
* Data sent: API key (server-side authorization), selected model, prompt instructions, and the post/page content you choose to process.
* When sent: When clicking Fetch Models, Test Connection, or Generate AI FAQs.
* Terms of Service: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

  1. OpenRouter

* Service purpose: Routes requests to selected AI models and returns available model IDs.
* Data sent: API key (server-side authorization), selected model, prompt instructions, and the post/page content you choose to process.
* When sent: When clicking Fetch Models, Test Connection, or Generate AI FAQs.
* Terms of Service: https://openrouter.ai/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://openrouter.ai/privacy

Important notes:
* External API calls are server-side. API keys are not exposed in frontend JavaScript.
* No data is sent to these services unless you actively use AI-related features.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the stella-smart-faq folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Stella FAQ > Settings and configure your AI provider.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin use external services?

Yes. The AI FAQ generator connects to external AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, OpenRouter) to generate FAQs. Your selected content is sent to the provider.

Can I manually create FAQs?

Yes. Use the FAQ post type to add questions and answers manually.
